.helpBody{padding:16px;display:grid;gap:14px}.helpHero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:14px}.helpCard{padding:14px;border:1px solid #343d45;border-radius:8px;background:#11161b}.helpCard h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.13em;color:#8fd7fa}.helpCard p{margin:6px 0;color:#b8c1c8;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}.helpSteps{display:grid;gap:7px;counter-reset:steps}.helpStep{display:grid;grid-template-columns:26px 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:start;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;color:#c9d0d5}.helpStep:before{counter-increment:steps;content:counter(steps);width:22px;height:22px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:#2c607a;color:white;font-weight:800;font-size:10px}.shortcutGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(160px,.8fr) 1fr;gap:6px 12px;font-size:11px}.shortcutGrid kbd{justify-self:start;padding:3px 7px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #4a535c;background:#22282e;box-shadow:0 1px 0 #ffffff12 inset;color:#e7ebee;font:700 10px/1.2 ui-monospace,monospace}.shortcutGrid span{color:#b4bdc4}.helpActions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.helpActions button{min-height:32px!important;height:32px!important;font-size:9px!important}.helpFine{font-size:10px!important;color:#87929b!important}
.p25Toast{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:42px;z-index:100000;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid #46515a;border-radius:6px;background:#161b20;color:#dbe1e5;box-shadow:0 12px 30px #0008;font:600 10px/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif;opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px);pointer-events:none;transition:.16s}.p25Toast.show{opacity:1;transform:none}

<body data-model="hr16">
<div class="desktopApp">
 <div class="appTitlebar"><div class="appIcon"></div><div class="appTitle">DM3AG Rhythm Lab <small>Drum Machine Studio</small></div><div class="appTitleSpacer"></div><div class="appSession">Untitled Kit • 120 BPM</div><div class="winBtns"><button class="winBtn" tabindex="-1">—</button><button class="winBtn" tabindex="-1">□</button><button class="winBtn close" tabindex="-1">×</button></div></div>
 <div class="appMenubar"><button class="menuBtn">File</button><button class="menuBtn">Edit</button><button class="menuBtn">View</button><button class="menuBtn">Tools</button><button class="menuBtn" id="helpMenuBtn">Help</button><div class="menuRight"><span><i class="statusLed on"></i>AUDIO</span><span>READY</span></div></div>
 <div class="appToolbar">
  <button class="toolBtn load" title="Load kit" onclick="document.getElementById('loadKitBtn')?.click()"></button><button class="toolBtn save" title="Save kit" onclick="document.getElementById('saveKitBtn')?.click()"></button><span class="toolSep"></span><button class="toolBtn undo" title="Undo" onclick="document.getElementById('undoBtn')?.click()"></button><button class="toolBtn redo" title="Redo" onclick="document.getElementById('redoBtn')?.click()"></button><span class="toolSep"></span><button class="toolBtn play" title="Play" onclick="document.getElementById('playBtn')?.click()"></button><button class="toolBtn stop" title="Stop" onclick="document.getElementById('stopBtn')?.click()"></button><span class="toolSep"></span><button class="toolBtn midi" title="MIDI" onclick="document.getElementById('midiBtn')?.click()"></button><button class="toolBtn settings" title="Settings" onclick="document.querySelector('.viewBtn[data-view=settings]')?.click()"></button><button class="toolBtn help" id="helpToolBtn" title="Help (F1)" aria-label="Help">?</button>
  <span class="toolSep"></span><span class="toolbarLabel">MODEL</span><span class="toolbarChip" id="appModelChip">HR-16 <b>OS 1.09</b></span><div class="toolbarChip appRomChip" title="All three machine sound sets are included in this file">SOUNDS <b id="appRomText">BUILT IN</b></div><span class="toolbarLabel">LENGTH</span><label class="toolbarChip appLenChip"><select id="appPatternLen" aria-label="Pattern length"><option value="16">16</option><option value="32" selected>32</option><option value="48">48</option><option value="64">64</option></select><b>STEPS</b></label><span class="toolbarLabel">TEMPO</span><span class="toolbarChip">120.0 BPM</span>
 </div>
 <div class="appMain"><aside class="appSidebar" id="appSidebar"></aside><main class="appContent">
<div class="machine">
 <div class="header">
  <div class="brandblock"><div class="eyebrow">CLASSIC DIGITAL DRUM MACHINE</div><div class="brand">DM3AG RHYTHM LAB</div><div class="sub">HR-16 • HR-16B • SR-16</div></div>
  <div class="modelname"><div class="productbadge">CLASSIC SERIES</div><span id="modelTitle">HR-16</span><div class="sub" id="modelSub">16-PAD DRUM MACHINE</div></div>
 </div>
 <div class="productNav" role="tablist"><button class="viewBtn active" data-view="play"><span>MACHINE</span><small>PLAY + SEQUENCE</small></button><button class="viewBtn" data-view="mixer"><span>MIXER</span><small>LEVEL + PAN</small></button><button class="viewBtn" data-view="browser"><span>VOICES</span><small>SOUND LIBRARY</small></button><button class="viewBtn" data-view="patterns"><span>PATTERNS</span><small>PATTERN LIBRARY</small></button><button class="viewBtn" data-view="settings"><span>SETTINGS</span><small>PREFERENCES</small></button></div>
 <div class="panel">
  <div class="modelBtns">
   <button class="modelBtn active" data-model="hr16">HR-16</button>

  </div>
  <div class="p20HardwareKeys p20LeftKeys" aria-label="Hardware function keys">
<button class="p20HwKey" data-p20-action="pattern">PATT</button><button class="p20HwKey" data-p20-action="song">SONG</button><button class="p20HwKey" data-p20-action="length">LENGTH</button>
<button class="p20HwKey" data-p20-action="quant">QUANT</button><button class="p20HwKey" data-p20-action="swing">SWING</button><button class="p20HwKey" data-p20-action="fill">FILL</button>
<button class="p20HwKey" data-p20-action="voice">VOICE</button><button class="p20HwKey" data-p20-action="tune">TUNE</button><button class="p20HwKey" data-p20-action="mix">MIX</button>
<button class="p20HwKey" data-p20-action="play">PLAY</button><button class="p20HwKey" data-p20-action="copy">COPY</button><button class="p20HwKey" data-p20-action="erase">ERASE</button>
</div>
  <div class="lcd">
   <div id="lcd1">HR-16 READY</div>

</div>

  </div>

   <button id="playBtn">PLAY</button><button id="stopBtn">STOP</button><button id="tapBtn">TAP TEMPO</button><button id="clearBtn">CLEAR</button><button id="panicBtn">PANIC</button><button id="hatTestBtn">TEST HAT CHOKE</button>

  <div class="qolbar primaryTools"><b>MODE</b><button id="advancedBtn" class="utilityBtn">MORE</button><button class="modeToggle active" id="authBtn">CLASSIC</button><button class="modeToggle" id="modernBtn">ENHANCED</button><button id="undoBtn">UNDO</button><button id="redoBtn">REDO</button><button id="saveKitBtn">SAVE KIT</button><button id="loadKitBtn">LOAD KIT</button><input id="kitFile" type="file" accept="application/json,.json" hidden><button id="midiBtn">ENABLE MIDI</button><span class="mini" id="midiStat">MIDI OFF</span><label class="mini">MIDI CH <select id="midiChan"><option value="0">OMNI</option><option value="1">1</option><option value="2">2</option><option value="3">3</option><option value="4">4</option><option value="5">5</option><option value="6">6</option><option value="7">7</option><option value="8">8</option><option value="9">9</option><option value="10">10</option><option value="11">11</option><option value="12">12</option><option value="13">13</option><option value="14">14</option><option value="15">15</option><option value="16">16</option></select></label><span class="mini p25HelpHint">Need shortcuts or editing tips? <button id="clearBarBtn">CLEAR BAR</button><button id="regressionBtn">RUN REGRESSION</button><button id="traceBtn">TRACE SR-16</button>

   </div>

  <div class="foot advancedPanel" id="accuracyNote"></div>
  <div class="foot advancedPanel">Technical playback notes: ROM decoding remains direct at the DM3AG 48 kHz source rate. HR hats use the proven shared hardware choke slot 2; DEV10 preserves the same slot replacement on both desktop and iOS buffer backends and crash uses the proven 11/12 alternating slots. Pan uses the seven proven firmware positions and a discrete switch-domain model. OUT1/OUT2 are kept as separate internal routes although an HTML browser ultimately exposes a stereo destination. The post-switch filter is a service-manual-topology model, not yet an electrical component-perfect transfer function.</div>

"use strict";

// DEV12 product navigation + mixer/browser workflow.
document.body.dataset.view="play";
function dev12Click(id){const e=document.getElementById(id);if(e)e.click();}
function dev12SetView(view){document.body.dataset.view=view;document.querySelectorAll('.viewBtn').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.view===view));if(view==='mixer')renderMixerView();if(view==='browser')renderVoiceBrowser();if(view==='patterns')renderHistoryPatterns();}
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{
 document.querySelectorAll('.viewBtn').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>dev12SetView(b.dataset.view)));
 const bind=(a,b)=>{const x=document.getElementById(a);if(x)x.addEventListener('click',()=>dev12Click(b));};
 bind('settingsAuth','authBtn');bind('settingsModern','modernBtn');bind('settingsMidi','midiBtn');bind('settingsSave','saveKitBtn');bind('settingsLoad','loadKitBtn');bind('settingsUndo','undoBtn');bind('settingsRedo','redoBtn');bind('settingsAdvanced','advancedBtn');bind('settingsRegression','regressionBtn');bind('settingsHat','hatTestBtn');
 const q=document.getElementById('voiceSearch');if(q)q.addEventListener('input',renderVoiceBrowser);
 document.querySelectorAll('.patternFilter').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{document.querySelectorAll('.patternFilter').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x===b));historyPatternFilter=b.dataset.pfilter||'all';renderHistoryPatterns();}));
});
function renderMixerView(){
 const g=document.getElementById('mixerGrid');if(!g||!window.padState)return;g.innerHTML='';
 padState.forEach((p,i)=>{const v=model.voices[p.voice]||model.voices[0];const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='mixStrip';
 d.innerHTML=`<h4>${i+1}. ${p.label}<br><span class="mini">${v.name}</span></h4><div class="mixerMeter"></div><label>LEVEL <input data-mix="vol" data-i="${i}" type="range" min="0" max="127" value="${p.vol}"></label><label>PAN <input data-mix="pan" data-i="${i}" type="range" min="-3" max="3" value="${p.pan}"></label><div class="row"><button data-mix="mute" data-i="${i}">${p.mute?'UNMUTE':'MUTE'}</button><button data-mix="solo" data-i="${i}">${p.solo?'UNSOLO':'SOLO'}</button></div>`;g.appendChild(d);});
 g.querySelectorAll('[data-mix="vol"]').forEach(e=>e.oninput=()=>{const i=+e.dataset.i;padState[i].vol=+e.value;if(i===selectedPad){document.getElementById('vol').value=e.value;document.getElementById('volv').textContent=e.value;}renderPads();});
 g.querySelectorAll('[data-mix="pan"]').forEach(e=>e.oninput=()=>{const i=+e.dataset.i;padState[i].pan=+e.value;if(i===selectedPad){document.getElementById('pan').value=e.value;document.getElementById('panv').textContent=e.value;}renderPads();});
 g.querySelectorAll('[data-mix="mute"]').forEach(e=>e.onclick=()=>{const i=+e.dataset.i;padState[i].mute=!padState[i].mute;renderPads();renderMixerView();});
 g.querySelectorAll('[data-mix="solo"]').forEach(e=>e.onclick=()=>{const i=+e.dataset.i;padState[i].solo=!padState[i].solo;renderPads();renderMixerView();});
}
function renderVoiceBrowser(){
 const list=document.getElementById('voiceList');if(!list||typeof model==='undefined'||!model)return;const q=(document.getElementById('voiceSearch')?.value||'').trim().toLowerCase();list.innerHTML='';
 const bp=document.getElementById('browserPad');if(bp)bp.textContent=padState[selectedPad]?.label||'—';const bm=document.getElementById('browserModel');if(bm)bm.textContent=model.display;
 model.voices.forEach((v,i)=>{const ptr=primaryPtr(v);const hay=`${v.num} ${v.name} ${ptr.toString(16)}`.toLowerCase();if(q&&!hay.includes(q))return;const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='voiceItem'+(padState[selectedPad]?.voice===i?' selected':'');d.innerHTML=`<span class="voiceNum">${String(v.num).padStart(3,'0')}</span><b>${v.name}</b><span class="voicePtr">$${ptr.toString(16).padStart(5,'0').toUpperCase()}</span>`;d.onclick=()=>{pushHistory?.();padState[selectedPad].voice=i;fillVoiceSelect();syncEditor();renderPads();renderVoiceBrowser();triggerPad(selectedPad,105);};list.appendChild(d);});
}

function historyPatternValid(p){for(const [role,exp] of Object.entries(p.expected||{})){if((p.roles[role]||[]).join(',')!==exp)return false;}return p.length===32&&p.bpm>0;}
function historyRolePad(role){
 const names=padState.map(p=>String(p.label||'').toUpperCase());
 const exact=(txt)=>names.findIndex(n=>n===txt);
 if(role==='kick')return names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('KICK'));
 if(role==='snare')return names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('SNARE'));
 if(role==='closedhat'){let i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('CLOSED HAT'));if(i<0)i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('CLOSED')&&n.includes('HAT'));return i;}
 if(role==='openhat'){let i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('OPEN HAT'));if(i<0)i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('OPEN')&&n.includes('HAT'));return i;}
 if(role==='clap'){let i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('CLAP'));if(i<0)i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('SNARE'));return i;}
 if(role==='cowbell'){let i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('COW'));if(i<0)i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('PERC'));if(i<0)i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('CLAVE'));return i;}
 if(role==='claves'){let i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('CLAVE'));if(i<0)i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('PERC'));if(i<0)i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('RIM'));return i;}
 if(role==='crash'){let i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('CRASH'));if(i<0)i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('CYMBAL'));return i;}
 if(role==='rim'){let i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('RIM'));if(i<0)i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('CLAVE'));if(i<0)i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('PERC'));return i;}
 if(role==='lowconga'){let i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('LOW CONGA'));if(i<0)i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('CONGA'));if(i<0)i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('LOW TOM'));if(i<0)i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('TOM'));return i;}
 if(role==='midconga'){let i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('MID CONGA'));if(i<0)i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('CONGA'));if(i<0)i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('MID TOM'));if(i<0)i=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes('TOM'));return i;}
 if(role.startsWith('tom')){const want=+(role.slice(3)||1);let idx=[];names.forEach((n,i)=>{if(n.includes('TOM'))idx.push(i);});if(idx[want-1]!=null)return idx[want-1];idx=[];names.forEach((n,i)=>{if(n.includes('PERC'))idx.push(i);});return idx[want-1]??-1;}
 return exact(role.toUpperCase());
}
function clearHistoryPatternData(){for(const r of pattern)r.fill(0);for(const r of stepMeta)for(let i=0;i<r.length;i++)r[i]={prob:1,ratchet:1};}
function loadHistoryPattern(id,playNow=false){const p=HISTORY_PATTERNS.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!p||!historyPatternValid(p)){lcd('PATTERN BLOCKED','SOURCE GRID VERIFY FAILED');return false;}pushHistory();stop();if(p.alesis&&p.id==='sp-1979-main'&&modelKey!=='sr16')setModel('sr16');patternLength=p.length;if($('patternLen'))$('patternLen').value=String(patternLength);clearHistoryPatternData();let missing=[];for(const [role,steps] of Object.entries(p.roles)){const pad=historyRolePad(role);if(pad<0){missing.push(role);continue;}for(const st of steps)if(st>=0&&st<patternLength)pattern[pad][st]=1;}if(missing.length){lcd('PATTERN BLOCKED','MISSING PAD: '+missing.join(','));return false;}$('bpm').value=String(p.bpm);$('bpmv').textContent=String(p.bpm);$('swing').value='50';$('swingv').textContent='50';renderPads();renderSeq();selectedPad=0;syncEditor();dev12SetView('play');lcd(`${p.artist} — ${p.title}`,`${p.section} • ${p.bpm} BPM • VERIFIED GRID`);if(playNow)setTimeout(()=>play(),80);return true;}
function historyPreview(p){const roleNames=Object.keys(p.roles);let html='<div class="patternGridPreview"><span></span>'+Array.from({length:16},(_,i)=>`<b>${i+1}</b>`).join('');for(const role of roleNames){html+=`<span class="lab">${role.toUpperCase()}</span>`;const set=new Set((p.roles[role]||[]).filter(x=>x<16));for(let i=0;i<16;i++)html+=`<i class="${set.has(i)?'on':''}"></i>`;}return html+'</div>';}
function renderHistoryPatterns(){const g=document.getElementById('historyPatternGrid');if(!g)return;g.innerHTML='';const visible=HISTORY_PATTERNS.filter(p=>historyPatternFilter==='all'||p.genre===historyPatternFilter||(historyPatternFilter==='alesis'&&p.alesis));for(const p of visible){const ok=historyPatternValid(p);const d=document.createElement('article');d.className='patternCard';d.innerHTML=`<div class="patternArtist">${p.artist}</div><h3>${p.title}</h3><div class="mini">${p.section}</div><div class="patternMeta"><span class="patternBadge verified">${ok?'GRID VERIFIED':'BLOCKED'}</span><span class="patternBadge ${p.genre}">${p.genre.toUpperCase()}</span>${p.alesis?'<span class="patternBadge alesis">ALESIS-LINKED</span>':''}<span class="patternBadge">${p.bpm} BPM</span><span class="patternBadge">${p.length} STEPS</span></div><div class="mini"><b>${p.machine}</b><br>${p.confidence}</div>${historyPreview(p)}<div class="patternActions"><button data-loadhist="${p.id}" ${ok?'':'disabled'}>LOAD PATTERN</button><button data-playhist="${p.id}" ${ok?'':'disabled'}>LOAD + PLAY</button></div><div class="patternSource">${p.sourceLabel}<br>${p.sources.map((u,i)=>`<a href="${u}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">SOURCE ${i+1}</a>`).join(' • ')}</div>`;g.appendChild(d);}g.querySelectorAll('[data-loadhist]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>loadHistoryPattern(b.dataset.loadhist,false));g.querySelectorAll('[data-playhist]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>loadHistoryPattern(b.dataset.playhist,true));const q=document.getElementById('historyResearchQueue');if(q)q.innerHTML=HISTORY_RESEARCH_QUEUE.map(x=>`<div class="queueItem"><span><b>${x[0]} — ${x[1]}</b><br>${x[2]}</span><span class="queueState">EXCLUDED</span></div>`).join('');}
